title: Rex and the Truck That Needed a Tiny Repair
synopsis: Rex's familiar wooden dump truck develops a stuck wheel, and the friends use the idea of a repair garage to solve a much smaller problem at home.
continuity_state: Before: Aunt Jo's yellow work van has been repaired and returned, Farmer Ruth's red tractor has a replacement battery, Ms. Pam's flatbed and white mobile service truck are based at the Red Door Garage, and Rex still owns his familiar wooden toy dump truck. After: Rex's wooden dump truck has its wheel freed of a wrapped ribbon with adult help. The toy remains at Rex's blue-step house. The garage remains a recurring neighborhood place; no further vehicle breakdown is pending. Jack adds a small picture of the fixed toy to his notebook.
